articles.author: Sebastian Weiss
articles.title: Urban Strorkes
articles.content: Urban Strorkes is an acclaimed photographic exploration of contemporary metropolitan form and organic geometry by photographer Sebastian Weiss. Through minimalist framing, dramatic natural lighting, and architectural abstractions, the series uncovers sculptural rhythms within everyday urban structures.
